Drakuseth, Maw of Flames/attack-four-to-: CR 603.3d/115.1d: all of the attack trigger's targets (4 damage to the opponent, 3 to each of up to two other targets) are chosen as it is put on the stack. A control answering that resolution-time choose with the two creatures kills both, so only the timing is wrong. Known root: same as Bite Down/second-target-is-chosen-on-cast (later targets asked at resolution, not on cast/trigger).
